name: dev-team
description: A role-based software development team: the lead agent decomposes a requirement and dispatches PM / architect / backend & frontend devs / QA / browser tester / reviewer subagents in dependency-aware serial-parallel stages.

description_i18n.zh-CN: 角色化软件开发团队：主代理作为技术负责人接收并拆解需求，按任务依赖与文件所有权串行/并行调度 PM、架构师、前后端工程师、QA、浏览器验收员、代码评审员等子智能体，全流程交付并贴真实测试输出。
description_i18n.en: A role-based software development team: the lead agent decomposes a requirement and dispatches PM / architect / backend & frontend devs / QA / browser tester / reviewer subagents in dependency-aware serial-parallel stages.
